meta.scope: Residential insulation data for Insulation Planner (Germany): legal targets, BEG funding requirements, U-value conventions, existing-construction defaults, products/pack sizes, retail and installed prices, old-material λ, safety notes, SEO phrases; brief AT/CH notes.
keyFindings: GEG was renamed Gebäudemodernisierungsgesetz (GModG) on 29.07.2026 (BGBl. 2026 I Nr. 226). Envelope values unchanged; paragraphs renumbered: § 47 -> § 35 (Nachrüstpflicht), § 48 -> § 36 (Änderung), Anlage 7 now zu § 36.

New BEG EM Richtlinie (17.07.2026, valid from 21.07.2026): envelope TMA U-values unchanged (wall 0.20, roof/top ceiling/flat roof 0.14, basement ceiling/floor 0.25); base grant 15 %; iSFP bonus +5 pp now only above 30,000 € and only on the part above it; WPB bonus +5 pp from Q1 2027.
EPS packs at OBI/BAUHAUS: 100 mm = 2 m² (not 3 m²).
caveats: Shared web-search budget ran out during research; Google/Bing autocomplete was not checked, so SEO popularity is inferred from page titles only.
DIN EN ISO 6946 / DIN 4108-4 texts (paid) were not accessed; Rsi/Rse from Wikipedia/Studyflix/KfW TFAQ, masonry λ from the official BBSR Altbauatlas.
BEG EM 2026 Richtlinie read from a copy hosted by Ingenieurkammer Niedersachsen; BAFA website confirms 15 %, 5 % iSFP with 30,000 € minimum, WPB from Q1 2027.
Retail prices are a single-day snapshot (2026-10-14); Hornbach blocked access.
Timber fraction is derived from rafter geometry (no authoritative default found).
meta.confidenceScale: high = primary source read directly; medium = reputable secondary source or retailer listing with derivation; low = single weak source, inference, or unverified

legalStatus2026.summary: The GEG (Gebäudeenergiegesetz) was amended and renamed 'Gebäudemodernisierungsgesetz (GModG)' (full title: 'Gesetz zur Einsparung von Energie und zur Modernisierung der Wärmeversorgung in Gebäuden'). Bundestag passed it on 10.07.2026, Bundesrat approved; promulgated in BGBl. 2026 I Nr. 226 on 28.07.2026; Article 1 (and 5, 6, 8) in force 29.07.2026; further articles (EPBD implementation) from 01.01.2027, zero-emission new-build standard 2028 (public) / 2030 (all). The reform focuses on heating rules (65%-EE rule dropped, §§ 42-46 new, §§ 71-72 deleted). Envelope rules were renumbered but not changed in value: old § 47 (Nachrüstung oberste Geschossdecke) -> § 35 GModG; old § 48 (Änderung von Außenbauteilen) -> § 36; old § 49 (U-Wert-Berechnung) -> § 37; Anlage 7 now 'zu § 36' (Art. 1 Nr. 53 only replaced the Anlage 7 heading). §§ 47 and 48 are now marked '(weggefallen)'. Article 2 (from 01.01.2027) changes only a footnote reference in Anlage 7 row 3a (special glazing).
legalStatus2026.note: Third-party site energie-m.de gives 23.07.2026 as publication date; buzer.de gives the amending law's date as 23.07.2026 (Ausfertigung) and BGBl. publication 28.07.2026. Use 29.07.2026 as entry into force. Many websites and the BEG Richtlinie still say 'GEG'; the BEG EM 2026 Richtlinie footnote says references to GEG are to be read as references to GModG.

beratungspflicht.text: § 36 Satz 3/4: Owners of Wohngebäude with max. 2 dwellings must have an (unentgeltliches) informatorisches Beratungsgespräch with an Energieausweis-Aussteller before commissioning planning if a whole-building calculation per § 38 is done instead; contractors must point this out in their offer.

calculationRule.text: § 37: U-value includes existing and new layers. Opaque components: DIN 4108-4:2017-03 with DIN EN ISO 6946:2008-04; components against ground: DIN V 18599-2:2018-09 Abschnitt 6.1.4.3; tapered insulation: DIN EN ISO 6946 Anhang C, minimum heat protection (§ 11 / DIN 4108-2) must be met at the thinnest point.

nachruestpflicht.who: Owners of Wohngebäude and of Nichtwohngebäude heated to >= 19 °C for >= 4 months per year.
nachruestpflicht.trigger: Oberste Geschossdecken that do not meet the Mindestwärmeschutz per DIN 4108-2:2013-02 must be insulated to U <= 0.24 W/(m²K). Duty is also met if the roof above is insulated accordingly or meets DIN 4108-2 minimum heat protection.
nachruestpflicht.limitedThickness: § 35 Abs. 2: if insulation between ceiling joists (Deckenzwischenräume) is technically limited, highest possible thickness with λ 0.035 (0.045 for blown-in or renewable materials) suffices; same for Zwischensparrendämmung limited by rafter height.
exceptions: § 35 Abs. 3: Wohngebäude with max. 2 dwellings where the owner occupied one dwelling on 01.02.2002: duty only applies to a new owner after the first ownership change after 01.02.2002; deadline 2 years after transfer.

§ 35 Abs. 4: Not applicable for owner-occupied buildings with max. 2 dwellings if the costs cannot be recovered by savings within a reasonable period (Wirtschaftlichkeit). Owner assesses this him/herself (no authority approval); economically viable partial measures must still be done (BBSR).
Under earlier law the general deadline for the duty was 31.12.2015 (BBSR).

mindestwaermeschutzThreshold.note: The trigger is 'does not meet DIN 4108-2:2013-02 minimum heat protection'. A thermal-resistance threshold for ceilings under unheated attics is commonly quoted as R >= 0.90 m²K/W (DIN 4108-2 Tabelle 3), but this was NOT verified against the (paid) standard in this research; treat as unverified.

grantRates.isfpBonusRule2026: From 21.07.2026: the 5-pp iSFP-Bonus only applies if förderfähige Ausgaben reach a minimum of 30,000 € (brutto) per application (for multi-unit buildings: the non-iSFP cap, e.g. 60,000 € for 3 units), and only to the part of the costs ABOVE the non-iSFP cap. Costs from several applications in the same calendar year are not added up. Example (1 dwelling, 50,000 € eligible, with iSFP): 30,000 × 15 % + 20,000 × 20 % = 8,500 € grant.
grantRates.isfpBonusRuleUntil20072026: 2023 guideline: +5 pp on all eligible costs if the measure is part of a funded iSFP (implemented within 15 years), with no minimum investment.

wpbBonus.rule: For Dämmmaßnahmen (Nr. 5.1 a) on a Worst Performing Building; requires the measure to be part of a funded iSFP (or owner not eligible for iSFP); no minimum investment; max 3 applications. WPB definition is in the BAFA 'Infoblatt zu den förderfähigen Maßnahmen und Leistungen' (not retrieved).

grantRates.maxCombinedRatePercent: 70 % (80 % for taxable household income <= 30,000 €) – only relevant when heating bonuses are combined; envelope measures get 15 % (+5 iSFP, +5 WPB from 2027).
grantRates.otherRequirements: Energieeffizienz-Experte (EEE) must be involved; building's Bauantrag/Bauanzeige at least 5 years ago; application before contracting.

changes2026: New BEG EM Richtlinie dated 17.07.2026, in force 21.07.2026 (valid to 31.12.2030).
TMA U-values for the envelope are unchanged vs. the 2023 version (verified line-by-line for walls, roofs, top-floor ceiling, flat roof, basement ceiling, floor slab).
Base rate for Gebäudehülle unchanged at 15 %.
iSFP-Bonus now only above a 30,000 € minimum and only on the amount above the non-iSFP cap (previously on all costs).
New WPB-Bonus (+5 pp) for insulation of Worst Performing Buildings expected from Q1 2027.

Heating-side changes (not envelope): cap 28,000 € for first dwelling falling 750 €/half-year from 01.02.2027; Einkommens-Bonus 40/30/10 pp; Klimageschwindigkeits-Bonus 16 pp falling to 0 by 01.08.2028.

taxAlternative.summary: Alternative to BEG grant (not combinable for the same measure): income-tax reduction of 7 % of costs in year 1 and 2 (max 14,000 € each) and 6 % in year 3 (max 12,000 €), max 40,000 € per object; owner-occupied building older than 10 years; executed by a Fachunternehmen with official certificate; Energieberater costs 50 %. Applies to measures begun after 31.12.2019 and completed before 01.01.2030 (§ 52 Abs. 35a EStG).

surfaceResistances.standard: DIN EN ISO 6946 (GModG § 37 references the 2008-04 edition; current DIN edition 2018-03)
surfaceResistances.horizontalDefinition: Heat flow within ±30° of the horizontal plane counts as 'horizontal' (Außenwand, Dachschräge steeper than 60°).

byElement.note: For roofs with strongly ventilated layer (hinterlüftete Dacheindeckung) ignore layers outside the ventilation gap and use Rse = Rsi (0.10) per DIN EN ISO 6946 / KfW TFAQ 3.06.
Ceiling to unheated attic: common practice is to use Rsi on both sides (unheated adjacent space treated like still air). Not verified against the norm text; source is an educational summary.
Ceiling to unheated basement: Rsi on both sides (downward heat flow). Same caveat as above.

Against ground. GModG § 37 requires DIN V 18599-2 Abschn. 6.1.4.3 for ground-contact elements; layers below the slab (Sauberkeitsschicht, Drainage, Schotter) must be ignored; only approved perimeter insulation (PB) below the slab may be counted (KfW TFAQ 3.07).

surfaceResistances.note: The Rsi values 0.10/0.13/0.17 and Rse 0.04 are the standard ISO 6946 table values (confirmed by Wikipedia; DIN text itself not accessed). Confidence for the basic table: high.

inhomogeneousLayers.rule: Inhomogeneous layers (e.g. Zwischensparrendämmung, insulation between Deckenbalken) must be calculated per DIN EN ISO 6946 Abschnitt 6.2: U from the arithmetic mean of upper and lower limit of the total thermal resistance R_T. Rafter/joist fraction must be considered; same for timber-frame walls, ceilings and floors.

designValues.rule: For German U-value calculations use the Bemessungswert λB (design value) of the insulation, not the nominal λD, where they differ. unknownExistingInsulation.rule: If the λ of existing (retrofitted) insulation is unknown: 0.04 W/(m·K) for mineral fibre and plastic foams, 0.05 W/(m·K) for insulation from renewable raw materials or blown-in insulation (official simplification for Bestand calculations).

kmf.summary: LfU Bayern: KMF (Glas-, Stein-, Schlackenwolle, Keramikfasern) produced before 2000 are generally classified as carcinogenic ('Alte Mineralwolle', TRGS 521); they can release respirable, poorly biodegradable fibres; hazard rated lower than asbestos. From 1996 production was changed step by step; from June 2000 only mineral wool with proven biosolubility may be placed on the market ('Freizeichnung gemäß Gefahrstoffverordnung' - RAL-Gütezeichen). GefStoffV Anhang II Nr. 5 (current text): biopersistent artificial mineral fibres (glassy silicate fibres with >18 % Na/K/Ca/Mg/Ba oxides, unless exempted e.g. by intratracheal half-life ≤ 40 days) 'dürfen weder hergestellt noch verwendet werden' for Wärme- und Schalldämmung im Hochbau. Baunetz Wissen states 'Seit 1998' only non-suspect mineral wool is approved in Germany - minor date discrepancy vs. LfU (June 2000 market ban).
kmf.cutoff: Produkte vor 2000 gelten generell als 'alte Mineralwolle' (krebserzeugend eingestuft); 1996 Einführung RAL-Gütezeichen und schrittweise Umstellung; ab Juni 2000 nur noch freigezeichnete (biolösliche) Mineralwolle. Practical rule for the calculator: unlabelled wool installed before ~1996 = treat as alte Mineralwolle; 1996-2000 = unklar unless RAL-Gütezeichen visible.
kmf.handling: TRGS 521 'Abbruch-, Sanierungs- oder Instandhaltungsarbeiten mit alter Mineralwolle' (edition cited by LfU: Februar 2008; current edition not verified - BAuA site returned 403). BG BAU Handlungsanleitung 'Umgang mit Mineralwolle-Dämmstoffen'. Disposal: KMF generally landfilled (ab Deponieklasse I); AVV 17 06 03* if hazardous; in Bavaria Überlassungspflicht an die öffentlich-rechtlichen Entsorgungsträger. Calculator UX: recommend not to disturb/remove old wool DIY; leave in place or have removed by a Fachbetrieb with dust-minimising methods.

asbestos.summary: Since 31 October 1993 production, placing on the market and use of asbestos are prohibited in Germany (EU-wide 2005). Removal/renovation/demolition work only by firms with the required qualification/authorisation; TRGS 519 must also be followed by private persons ('Sie ist auch von Privatpersonen einzuhalten'). Intact, firmly bound asbestos-cement does not automatically have to be removed. UBA notes TRGS 519 is being revised. Any machining (sanding, drilling, breaking) releases fibres.
asbestos.years: Verbot in DE seit 31.10.1993 (UBA, BG BAU); LfU timeline: 1979 Spritzasbest (BRD) verboten, 1982 asbesthaltige Bodenbeläge, 1984 schwach gebundene Asbestprodukte im Bau und Nachtspeicher, 1992 Asbestzementplatten im Hochbau, 1993 Herstellungsverbot, 1995 weitgehendes Herstellungs- und Verwendungsverbot, 2005 EU. Eternit/Glasal Faserzement bis 1991 asbesthaltig. Treat buildings built/renovated before ~1993-1995 as suspect.
asbestos.where_found: Asbestzement (Dach- und Fassadenplatten, Blumenkästen, Fallrohre, Kabelkanäle); Putze, Spachtelmassen, Fliesenkleber (fest gebunden; on-site additive esp. 1960s/70s); Floor-Flex/Vinyl-Asbest-Platten, Rückenbeschichtung von Cushion-Vinyl, schwarzbraune Bitumenkleber; Spritzasbest (mainly industry/large buildings); some Nachtspeicheröfen. Insulation contexts: Teerpappen under Fehlbodenschüttungen (PAK- und Asbestverdacht), asbestos fabric on old Teerkork-Rohrschalen, Dünnbettmörtel/Kleber of Teerkork; DDR products Baufatherm, Neptunit, Sokalit (schwach gebunden).
